title: Harbor · token refresh review
provenance: Product demo · fictional tasks and messages. No agents or providers run during capture.
parentExcerpt:
I split this fictional task into four bounded workstreams. Each worker has a distinct responsibility; I will review the changes before integrating them.

### Keep the public API stable

- Share the in-flight token refresh between callers.
- Exercise both success and rejection paths.
- Check that retry remains possible after a failure.
- Update the developer notes with the concurrency guarantee.

### Review before merge

The test reviewer is checking the regression case independently. No merge or deployment is authorized.

This is demonstration data, not a live run or a performance claim.

tracks.label: Refresh implementation
tracks.task: Own src/auth.ts. Share the pending promise and clear it after settlement. Do not change exported signatures.

tracks.label: Regression tests
tracks.task: Own src/auth.test.ts. Prove two concurrent callers share a request, and a rejected request permits a later retry.

tracks.label: Independent review
tracks.task: Review the diff without editing implementation. Look for stale promises, dropped errors and test gaps.

tracks.label: Developer notes
tracks.task: Describe the concurrency contract and caller-visible failure behavior. Do not claim unmeasured speedups.

approvalExcerpt: Keep the regression deterministic: control the pending promise in the test instead of sleeping. Assert one fetch, both callers resolving, and a fresh request after rejection. These are fictional task instructions, not an acceptance result.
